name: High Kick Through The Roof
description:
Two sisters, twenty-two and nine in age, lived all their lives with their father, deep in the country where even electricity is an unaffordable luxury. One day, after a bizarre turn of events, they end up in Seoul. The two sisters encounter a severe case of cultural shock as soon as they hit the city. Building forests, computers, department stores, subways, cell phone To 9-year old Shin-ae, who had never seen these before, Seoul is like a fantasy that can sometimes be difficult to fathom.

Meanwhile, a peculiar family lives at a corner of a residential area in Seongbuk-dong.

Sun-jae is the president of a small food company.

At 72, Sun-jae falls head over heels in love just as his life is slowly winding down. His granddaughter Hae-ri shrieks every morning in the bathroom over her constipation. All the other members of this family have some sort of defect. The most invisible son-in-law in Seongbuk-dong, the EQ-deficient doctor, the perverted female teacher Come to think of it, every man living in this day and age harbors some kind of unique defect.

This is why they shout confidently, "Only those of you who are perfect may throw stones at us!" is a sitcom portraying the uplifting comedic story of two sisters who begin to work at Sun-jae's house as maids and their episodes with members of this family. At the same time, it is a drama of these two girls blossoming into young women as they fall in love.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Se Kyung and Shin Ae live in the deep woods of the Taebaek Mountains with their dad. After going through twists and turns, the sisters finally set foot in Seoul. Will Se Kyung and Shin Ae be welcomed in Seoul, the city of dreams? Everything is so new to Shin Ae, but Se Kyung is too afraid to do anything in this unfamiliar land without their dad.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Se Kyung and Shin Ae are all by themselves in Seoul without their dad. To keep the promise they made to their dad, the sisters head to the N Seoul Tower. But while on their way, they lose all of their money. Meanwhile, Soon Jae and Ja Ok come to a crisis of being caught by the students.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Hyeon Gyeong is extremely suspicious about whether her father is in a romantic relationship with the vice-principal. Meanwhile, without getting to eat anything at all, Se Kyung and Shin Ae endlessly wait for their father, who doesn't seem to come for them.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Shin Ae and Se Kyung manage to find a place to stay temporarily, thanks to Julien's kindness. Meanwhile, Jung Eum becomes Jun Hyuk's tutor to pay her credit card bill, but she soon realizes that Jun Hyuk is the worst student that any tutor can ever have.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Soon Jae promises Ja Ok that he'll be there on September 11 for her birthday. However, he can't help but feel uneasy. He tries to remember what's on that day, but it just doesn't come up in his mind. Meanwhile, Se Kyung leaves Julien's house as she doesn't want to be more nuisance to him.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Bo Seog notices Soon Jae is in a relationship with Ja Ok, but he promises to keep it secret. However, Hyeon Gyeong suspects something is suspicious after witnessing Bo Seog acting awkwardly. She is determined to find out what he is hiding about Soon Jae, so she starts to ask him questions. Meanwhile, Shin Ae gets lost, and Se Kyung searches everywhere for her. She feels devastated because she can't find her, so she asks for help from other people.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Jun Hyuk suddenly gets a high score on his English test, and his teacher at school suspects him of cheating. Jun Hyuk tries to persuade him that he didn't cheat, but it's hard for the teacher to believe his words. Meanwhile, Hyeon Gyeong tenaciously tries to find out the truth about Soon Jae's relationship with Ja Ok. Soon Jae desperately tries to hide the truth from her as he knows she'll bring up her late mother.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Soon Jae's family members are disappointed in Soon Jae for his lies and behaviors, but he just can't give up on his love for Ja Ok. Meanwhile, Se Kyung happens to run into Ji Hoon once again while struggling to get used to her new work at a gas station.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Se Kyung begins working as a live-in housekeeper for Soon Jae's family after some tough difficulties, but Hyeong Gyeong isn't so happy about the idea of hiring her. Meanwhile, Shin Ae is frustrated that she has to put up with Hae Ri's mean attitude.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Soon Jae can't accept the fact that Ja Ok wants to break up with him. So he waits in front of her house until she comes out to meet him despite the heavy rain. Meanwhile, Jung Eum asks Ji Hoon to give her a ride to a subway station and ends up going to Sokcho with him.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Soon Jae gets his love back, but he catches bad flu from getting rained heavily. Hyeon Gyeong asks Se Kyung to make some pine nut porridge for Soon Jae, and she makes it with the millstone which once belonged to Hyeong Gyeong's late mother.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Jung Eum becomes famous overnight. But rather than being excited about it, she quivers with rage. So she comes up with a plan to get revenge on Ji Hoon. Meanwhile, Ja Ok and Hyeon Gyeong share a room on the school staff retreat. But before going to bed, Ja Ok shocks Hyeon Gyeong.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: For Julien's birthday, Se Kyung and Shin Ae try to get him a gift. But since they don't have enough money, they ponder what to give him. And at last, the sisters come up with something! Meanwhile, Soon Jae's name was misspelled on his new nameplate due to Bo Seog's mistake.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Soon Jae is excited to go out on a date with Ja Ok. He is enjoying a meal with her in a restaurant when a server there mistakes him for Ja Ok's father. He suddenly feels he has to make an effort to look young to date Ja Ok, so he goes to a cosmetic surgery clinic. Meanwhile, Hae Ri gets a dollhouse as a present from her relative. Shin Ae is jealous of her and wants to have a dollhouse too.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Se Ho falls for Jung Eum the moment he sees her with her hair wet. He starts to daydream about her and even makes a bold move. Meanwhile, Bo Seog fails to close a deal with a client because he forgets to go to the meeting. Soon Jae gets angry and even says he shouldn't have let Hyeon Gyeong marry him. Feeling hurt, Bo Seog leaves the house and doesn't answer Hyeon Gyeong's phone calls. She goes out to look for him, reminiscing about the past when she dated him.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Hae Ri and her friends pick on Shin Ae for not attending school, so Se Kyung tries to send Shin Ae to school. But preparing for school is not so easy. Meanwhile, Soon Jae and Ja Ok run into Julien. Julien greets Ja Ok in the American style, but it seems too friendly to Soon Jae.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Jun Hyuk doesn't like Jung Eum, so he gets her fired. However, she reacts to it with a calm attitude. Jun Hyuk is supposed to be happy that he will no longer see her, but he feels uncomfortable for some reason. Meanwhile, Bo Seog admires Ji Hoon's intelligence. He prevents Ji Hoon from getting injured by getting hurt himself.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Childish and petty confrontations start. Ja Ok and Hyeon Gyeong engage in a war of nerves, which leads them to exact revenge on each other in a ridiculous way. Meanwhile, Jung Eum goes on a blind date, hoping to start a relationship. She gets excited to see that his date is a handsome guy. The date seems to go smoothly, but she encounters an obstacle.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Everyone should be happy as it's Chuseok. However, Se Kyung and Shin Ae become despondent because they can't help thinking about their dad. Meanwhile, Hyeon Gyeong is not happy either because Chuseok reminds her of an incident that happened five years ago. She wants to forget about it, but she can't. Bo Seog is restless and uncomfortable as she is feeling angry.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Se Kyung receives her first salary, which makes her and Shin Ae excited. However, Jung Eum is in a dire situation, so she borrows money from Se Kyung. Se Kyung finds out that Jung Eum doesn't have a good track record when it comes to paying the borrowed money back, so she starts to take drastic measures. Meanwhile, Soon Jae accompanies Ja Ok to a get-together she goes to regularly. He rides a bicycle to the get-together as Ja Ok finds cycling sexy, but something unexpected happens!

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Jung Eum is disheartened after failing to get a chance to have a job interview many times in a row. Se Ho follows Jung Eum around like a stalker and gets caught again. Hae Ri and Shin Ae practice "Cinderella" for the school play day.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Hae Ri's new doll, Lloyd, has disappeared! She suspects Shin Ae has taken it while Se Kyung tries to defend her sister. Ji Hoon deploys his exceptional deductive skills to find the doll. Meanwhile, Soon Jae visits Ja Ok as she is sick. While they have a good time drinking tea, someone else comes to Ja Ok's house.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Bo Seog can't do anything right as usual. Soon Jae and Hyeon Gyeong boss him around, telling him what to do and how to do it. Then he hears from Se Ho and Shin Ae that he has no authority in his house and is treated poorly by his family members. He decides to take measures to correct this. Meanwhile, Jun Hyuk goes to see a musical with Jung Eum with complimentary tickets he got from Soon Jae. Surprisingly, Ji Hoon and Se Kyung are also there to see the musical!

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Ja Ok has a preconception about Kwang Soo. She is convinced that Kwang Soo is behind all the bad things that happen in her house. Meanwhile, Shin Ae is held by a local food vendor after Hae Ri pulls a prank on her. Se Kyung does all she can to save her.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Jun Hyuk is skeptical about Jung Eum's attending university, and Ji Hoon keeps talking about Seoul National University, which Jung Eum doesn't attend. Jung Eum gets anxious that people will find out about her school. Meanwhile, Bo Seog and Hyeon Gyeong get nervous about Hae Ri's IQ test.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Jung Eum, Kwang Soo, and In Na look for the woman who took Ja Ok's lodge money. And Se Kyung joins the team. They all have their own purposes for catching the lady, but for the time being, they work together. Meanwhile, Soon Jae and Hyeon Gyeong get shocked by what Ji Hoon said.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Shin Ae loves to read books so much that she feels like she gets sores in her mouth if she doesn’t read, but Hae Ri is just not interested whatsoever. Shin Ae struggles to read books avoiding Hae Ri’s watch. Meanwhile, Se Kyung unintentionally gives Bo Seog clout.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Soon Jae goes on a date with Ja Ok but suddenly feels like farting. He tries to hold it, knowing that Ja Ok doesn't like people who fart in a public place. Meanwhile, Jung Eum takes her dog, Hit-it, to her tutoring session as the dog is sick. Ji Hoon shows an allergic reaction to the dog and tells Jung Eum to take it outside. She gets angry at Ji Hoon and comes up with a plan to get back at him.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Jung Eum wants to get discharged from the hospital quickly, but Ji Hoon tries to stop her for some reason. She gets angry at him, thinking he is pulling a prank on her. Meanwhile, Soon Jae wants to plan a surprise for the 100th day together with Ja Ok. Not being able to come up with a plan, he asks for Bo Seog's help.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Hyeon Gyeong accidentally causes Ja Ok to get injured and offers to carry her on her back. Ja Ok makes the most of this opportunity and comes up with plans to make her suffer. Meanwhile, Jung Eum takes offense when she sees Jun Hyuk talk to Se Kyung politely while he is always rude to her. She decides to take measures to make him treat her respectfully.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Se Kyung visits Ji Hoon at the hospital to bring him some broth and a change of clothes. His fellow doctors mistake her for his girlfriend and spread rumors that he has a hot girlfriend. Hyeon Gyeong, Jung Eum, and Se Kyung are all curious about who Ji Hoon's girlfriend is. Meanwhile, Lee Soon Jae Food and Beverage tries to close a deal with a Japanese company. And the Japanese buyers find Bo Seog attractive.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Hae Ri gets her head injured and suffers from memory loss. Not remembering who Shin Ae is, she thinks Shin Ae is her friend and acts kindly toward her. Meanwhile, Se Ho tries to get over Jung Eum, but it's not easy as she is nice to him.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Hae Ri invites her boyfriend, Kyo Bin, home, and a love triangle begins between the two and Shin Ae. Mistaken for a student, Se Kyung happens to participate in a gym class in school, where she discovers her hidden talent.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: What should a family be like? Bo Seog is frustrated with how everyone looks down on him. Hyeon Gyeong doesn't get how Soo Jae can be indifferent to the family except for his lover, and Soon Jae is upset that Hyeon Gyeong opposes everything he suggests. Meanwhile, Kwang Soo and In Na can't enjoy their food because of Jung Eum.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Who is the actual big shot of Lee Soon Jae Food and Beverage? Everyone asks Soon Jae to hire someone they know as his secretary. Meanwhile, Jung Eum leaves Hit-it with Ji Hoon, but Hit-it disappears. So Ji Hoon and Jung Eum desperately look for Hit-it.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: After Shin Ae gets the taste of a claw machine, she gets addicted to it. And she even ends up stealing money from Se Kyung. Will she be back as the good girl she was? Meanwhile, Se Ho suffers great pain.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Jun Hyuk's friends are divided into two groups. Some boys think Jung Eum is prettier, and the others are in favor of Se Kyung. They even conduct a popularity poll to decide who is better-looking. Even Jun Hyuk's family members have something to say about the looks of the two ladies. Meanwhile, a strange man appears naked before Bo Seog and mysteriously talks about the future.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Soon Jae has to close an important deal with another company, and he needs to take an interpreter to the meeting with the company. After Ja Ok recommends Julien, he decides to hire him as the interpreter. Thanks to Julien's fluent English and French, Soon Jae successfully closes the deal. However, there is something he doesn't like about him. Meanwhile, Se Kyung receives a higher salary than usual from Hyeon Gyeong, which makes both Se Kyung and Shin Ae happy.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Soon Jae tells Ja Ok a lie that he plans to give her 10,000 paper cranes as a gift to move her heart. Shin Ae and Hae Ri have homework to draw what they want to be in the future. But Shin Ae's dream seems to change constantly.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: For Bo Seog, autumn and his trench coat are always special. In his memories, Michelle and her last words will always remain. Meanwhile, Se Kyung and Jung Eum get to have a drink together. Ji Hoon and Jun Hyuk are surprised to see how different they've become after getting drunk.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Jung Eum gets pissed off because she feels like Jun Hyuk belittles her when he's polite to Se Kyung. Jung Eum comes up with a creative idea to teach him a lesson. Meanwhile, Julien becomes an English-speaking teacher. But Ja Ok is unhappy about how he and Hyeon Gyeong seem close.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Ji Hoon asks Hyeon Gyeong to be his partner at a charity event, but she suggests Se Kyung go instead. Se Kyung is reluctant, but she agrees in the end. However, something comes up, so Ji Hoon ends up going to the event with Jung Eum. She spends a perfect day with Ji Hoon. Meanwhile, Jun Hyuk almost doesn't recognize Se Kyung in her new clothes. And Bo Seog tries to release stress as the doctor suggested.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Se Kyung now has a cell phone, and people around her teach her how to use it. Bo Seog makes a mistake at work. Afraid of Soon Jae, who is very angry, Bo Seog runs away from home and stays in Ja Ok's place.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: A class field day is held at Shin Ae and Hae Ri's school to celebrate Father's Day. Shin Ae takes Julien, and Hae Ri takes Soon Jae in place of their dads. A girl suddenly asks Jun Hyuk out and doesn't seem to give up on him easily. So Jun Hyuk asks Jung Eum a strange favor.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: To pay back for the lavish anniversary event he held for Ja Ok, Soon Jae decides to cut the household expenses in half and puts Se Kyung in charge of the job. While trying to remove her face on buses taken for a promotional photo for her school, Jung Eum runs into Ji Hoon.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Soon Jae's old friend does a compatibility check for Soon Jae and Ja Ok and tells them they are not well-suited. A man repeatedly makes prank calls to Se Kyung's phone, pretending to be her father. But when they least expect it, Dal Ho calls up his daughters, Se Kyung and Shin Ae.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Jung Eum is just anxious about the fact that Ji Hoon knows about her school. Soon Jae and his family offer Jung Eum to join breakfast, but at the table, Ji Hoon mentions the word “Seowoon,” and Jung Eum faints after hearing him say it. Eventually, Jung Eum asks Ji Hoon an earnest request.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Shin Ae sends her story to the radio station to win a prize for Se Kyung. Maybe her desperate prayer was granted, and her story gets aired all over Korea on the radio. But Soon Jae’s company suffers because of Shin Ae’s story. Ms. Kim and her tenants put their money in stock investment based on Kwang Soo’s words.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: After taking some pills, Bo Seog strangely becomes very emotional and extra. Meanwhile, Se Kyung hides the fact that she’s sick, but no one notices. However, only Ji Hoon notices that she’s not feeling well. Ji Hoon’s careful concern makes Se Kyung’s heart flutter.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Frustrated by the fact that Shin Ae seems to outdo Hae Ri in everything, Hyeon Gyeong takes Hae Ri for morning runs to help her beat Shin Ae at running. Ja Ok is generous to her boarders, but in fact, she and Kwang Soo devise a scheme to raise the rent.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Jun Hyuk learns that Se Kyung is studying for the GED, and he promises to help her with English. Soon Jae agrees to Bo Seog's idea of sponsoring a basketball player to help make donations to a childhood cancer charity. It turns out that Bo Seog made a major mistake with the contract terms.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Soon Jae provokes Mr. Hong and Mr. Hong counterattacks. Soon Jae had his guard down while he was being attacked. Will he be defeated just like that? Meanwhile, after Hae Ri was banned from using the word “annoying fart,” she became quiet. Everyone tries to remember when Hae Ri first used the word “annoying fart.” But will Hae Ri be able to do well in her speech contest?

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Jung Eum notices that no one wants to be friendly to Hae Ri, so she offers to be her friend. But Se Ho warns her she may suffer in the future. Meanwhile, Jun Hyuk runs into Bo Seog outside the house, trembling in the cold.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: After watching her beautiful gayageum performance, Julien’s mother gives Jung Eum a gift. Seeing that, Kwang Soo and In Na try hard to impress Julien’s mother. Meanwhile, Mr. Yun wants to recruit Se Kyung as an athlete and offers her a tempting proposition.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Ji Hoon gets into an accident while trying to save Jung Eum, who was too drunk. He plays a prank, and she promises to take responsibility for what happened. Meanwhile, Shin Ae gets full marks on her test. As a reward, Hyeon Gyeong takes Shin Ae and Hae Ri to a buffet.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: A friend of Soon Jae's sends him Korean native chickens from the countryside. Hae Ri opens the cage out of curiosity, setting the chickens free in the yard. So the Lee family comes together to regain the yard from the wild chickens. After seeing how well Julien plays basketball, some girls at Pungpa High create his fan club.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Jung Eum sees a drawing of a woman's face in Jun Hyuk's notebook, which resembles her. After a conversation with In Na, she wonders if he has liked her all along. Bo Seog makes a moment's mistake that leaves him feeling embarrassed in front of his family.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Soon Jae realizes that his family members know very little about him. So he holds the first Lee Soon Jae Exam and makes everyone take it. Meanwhile, Jung Eum feels upset that Jun Hyuk treats her differently from Se Kyung. She calls him up to play a game of Truth or Dare.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Shin Ae wants to go to the ocean, thinking she can be close to her dad near the sea. Se Kyung promises her that she'll take her to the ocean someday. After hearing them talk, Jun Hyuk decides to help them to get to the ocean. Meanwhile, Julien learns a traditional Koran folk song from Jung Eum. And Soon Jae misses his late mom as her birthday is drawing near.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Bo Seog takes Hyeon Gyeong to a gathering with his friends. All the other friends' wives publicly show their love for their husbands. Bo Seog wants Hyeon Gyeong to do the same, but she refuses. And he feels like he was humiliated in front of his friends. Meanwhile, Julien's old friend visits him. She says he is Julien's girlfriend, and Shin Ae feels jealous.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Ji Hoon sees Jung Eum shaking with cold and gives her a ride. They both have plans with their friends, but it suddenly starts to snow. Both of their friends cancel on them, so they decide to go somewhere together to enjoy the first snowfall of the season. Meanwhile, Bo Seog hurts his back and sleeps in Se Kyung's room to apply heat to his back. But things don't go his way, and he blames Se Kyung.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Bo Seog, who always gets scolded by Soon Jae, has a chance to shine by himself. The executives at Lee Soon Jae Food and Beverage participate in an athletic meeting, and Bo Seog shows off his athletic skills. Meanwhile, Se Kyung is surprised that Hae Ri's phone bill is 80 dollars. She is curious to know how much her phone bill is, so she asks Ji Hoon about the bill. After she finds out that he is paying her phone bill, she feels like she owes him something. She tries to pay it back, but Ji Hoon doesn't feel too comfortable with it.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Since Hae Ri has no understanding of subtraction, Hyeon Gyeong and Bo Seog try hard to teach her the concept of it. But it doesn’t seem to go well. Jun Hyuk and Jung Eum become awkward. Will the two be able to overcome the awkwardness between them?

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Bo Seog can't help but feel that Se Kyung is looking down on him. So he continues to be mean to her, and Se Kyung just doesn't get why he is taking out on her. Meanwhile, feeble brothers have come to Ms. Kim's house. They fall for In Na's beauty and start to act weird.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Jun Hyuk finds out that his underpants has gone missing after he comes out of the shower. And it turns out that Se Kyung has been washing his underpants all along. Meanwhile, everyone gets amazed by Julien's fit build.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Se Kyung and Shin Ae, who have always been getting along, fight for the first time. Shin Ae complains that she can't do anything as she wants in the house, and Se Kyung thinks that Shin Ae acts up. Meanwhile, Ji Hoon and Jung Eum keep bumping into each other unexpectedly in awkward situations.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Hyeon Gyeong and Ja Ok, who have never gotten along, work together toward a common goal. Meanwhile, Mr. Im comes to Soon Jae's house and has a meal with him. Mr. Im falls in love with Se Kyung at first sight and starts to make a move on her. But she feels extremely uncomfortable and awkward.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Soon Jae is displeased with Bo Seog getting all happy and excited when it comes to Japan. Meanwhile, Jun Hyuk starts to study hard before his final exam. His teacher Jung Eum is touched by his enthusiasm and helps him study with passion.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Jung Eum tries to avoid Ji Hoon after she spots him at a café, but he sees her. Ji Hoon points out that her skirt is too short to wear in winter, and Jung Eum gets upset. Soon Jae and Mr. Hong quarrel again and decide to play a basketball game. To win the game, Soon Jae heads somewhere.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: It's Hyeon Gyeong's birthday, but every member of her family is busy with their own plans. She pretends not to care but is disappointed that no one is at home to celebrate her birthday. Meanwhile, Kwang Soo and In Na get worried that there is no food left for them to eat. When the poor couple is about to starve, someone approaches In Na and offers to give her food for free.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Bo Seog feels frustrated as he always gets scolded by Soon Jae. But then he finds something that will relieve his stress and gets into it. Meanwhile, Se Kyung doesn't like that Jung Eum makes a mess in the house and wears her scarf without permission. They play a game together by chance, but it becomes an intense fight!

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Soon Jae takes Bo Seog, Ji Hoon, and Jun Hyuk on a trip. But Bo Seog acts clumsily and keeps making mistakes throughout the journey. Meanwhile, Kim Beom, a handsome engineering student and Ja Ok's nephew, shows up at her place one day. Jung Eum and In Na fall for Beom's charms.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Hae Ri takes everything Shin Ae has. So Jun Hyuk comes up with a plan to break her bad habit once and for all. Ja Ok visits the hospital for a checkup and warms up to Ji Hoon. After hearing that he doesn't have a girlfriend, she decides to find a good match for him.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Se Kyung helps an old lady on the street who makes a job offer with good pay. Ja Ok decides to sell her house, and a man comes to see the house as soon as she puts it on the market. Jung Eum, Julien, Kwang Soo, and In Na are shocked at the unexpected news.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Jung Eum looks forward to her date with Ji Hoon on Christmas Eve. But he gets caught up with work and calls her at the last minute. Se Kyung and Shin Ae make a Christmas tree together. Ja Ok and Soon Jae go on a date, but Soon Jae is not happy when Julien shows up with Ja Ok.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Hyeon Gyeong gives Se Kyung a bonus and allows her to take a day off. But Se Kyung doesn’t know what to do with this sudden freedom. So she just heads outside of the house all by herself. Ja Ok visits Soon Jae’s house, determined to get closer to Hyeon Gyeong. However, Soon Jae has to leave for work, leaving Ja Ok and Hyeon Gyeong alone in the house.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Hae Ri and Jun Hyuk constantly bicker. Hae Ri finds out that the love of her life, Rain, is performing at a concert Jun Hyuk is going, and she asks him to take her with him. However, Jun Hyuk would never take her with him, so he left her behind. Jung Eum gets shocked by how Ji Hoon introduced her as “just someone he knows” to his acquaintance.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Bo Seog learns a secret skill in rock-paper-scissors that makes him win in every game he plays with his family. Jung Eum and Ji Hoon go on their second date. He notices that her fingers are more swollen than usual and suggests she get a medical checkup.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: On New Year's Eve, Soon Jae's family, Ja Ok, and Jung Eum get together at Soon Jae's house. Cham, Soon Jae's brother, visits him from America. Cham suggests that they get divided into two teams and play games. Meanwhile, Kwang Soo wants to go on a ski trip, so he tries to borrow Julien's season pass.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Jun Hyuk hurts his leg while trying to help Se Kyung with household chores. Meanwhile, Soon Jae passes out in his office one day. And a rumor spreads that Soon Jae will retire and Bo Seog will become the next president. So Mr. Bong tries to win his favor.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Jung Eum is upset because she always feels small before Ji Hoon and his friends. One day, Ji Hoon and Jung Eum run into a couple. And a woman called Shin Ji keeps staring at Jung Eum with a suspicious look. Hyeon Gyeong doesn’t like how Ja Ok always steps back at everything just because she’s a woman. To prove Ja Ok wrong, Hyeon Gyeong tries to show that what men can do, women can do too.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: During a lesson, Se Kyung asks Jun Hyuk about math problems, which baffles Jun Hyuk. Feeling embarrassed, Jun Hyuk looks for someone who can help Se Kyung solve math problems. After Hae Ri witnesses Shin Ae on Julien’s shoulders, she also tries to ride on Bo Seog’s shoulders, but he can barely stand up. Hae Ri is so determined to ride on Julien’s shoulders that she does everything she can.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Soon Jae invites Ja Ok to come to his place. She uses the bathroom at his place, but then the toilet is clogged. She doesn't want anyone to know about it, so she desperately tries to unclog the toilet. Meanwhile, Jun Hyuk pulls a prank on Se Kyung in front of Ji Hoon, and she gets mad at him. Jun Hyuk is surprised and baffled and becomes cold and aloof toward Se Kyung.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Jung Eum gets a call and hears that she can't graduate as she is short of credits. She decides to do volunteer work at the hospital where Ji Hoon works as a way of earning the credits she needs. However, she encounters a strange old man on her first day at the hospital. Meanwhile, Bo Seog spots the scooter Jun Hyuk bought and wants to ride it to relieve his stress.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Soon Jae buys a diamond ring to propose to Ja Ok, but it goes missing. And Bo Seog and Se Kyung search the house for the ring. Ji Hoon meets a man at the hospital who says he was his senior during his military service. He suggests that they become friends.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Jung Eum is bothered by the fact that Ji Hoon is paying for all the dates they go on. Then, she gets a call that she won prize money of 1,000 dollars. One day, Hae Ri sees Se Ho dancing to a song of Rain's and falls for his charms. But Jun Hyuk tells her that Se Ho likes Jung Eum, who is prettier than her.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Today is Jun Hyuk's birthday, so Jun Hyuk and Se Kyung plan to go to watch a movie together. Se Kyung stays up all night long to make beef bone broth for Ji Hoon, as always. Hyeon Gyeong and Julien play around like kids and end up in a tragedy.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: One day, Ja Ok runs into Young Gyu, an old neighbor. He takes her out for a drive and spends time with her. Ja Ok is swayed as this younger guy seems manly and romantic. When Soon Jae proposes to Ja Ok, she is reluctant to give yes as an answer.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Jung Eum, who lacks perseverance, finally lands a job. She is excited on her first day to work, and Ji Hoon roots for her. Meanwhile, Bo Seog is diagnosed with depression, so he decides to follow his father's words to see everything in a positive light.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Se Ho notices that Jun Hyuk has a crush on Se Kyung. So he starts to write a fictitious love story of the two and post it on his blog. Hyeon Gyeong believes that Hae Ri is talented in sports, so she makes her learn figure skating.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Bo Seog is terrified to know that a snake has gotten loose in the house and becomes madly engaged in catching it. Meanwhile, In Na and Jung Eum make a silly bet on who gets to seduce the other's boyfriend first.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Bo Seog is upset that Hyeon Gyeong humiliates him every time they meet with his friends, and they begin their childish quarrel. Meanwhile, Se Kyung runs into Ji Hoon on her way back from running an errand for Soon Jae.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Hyeon Gyeong is not happy with Soon Jae marrying Ja Ok, so Bo Seog and Soon Jae plan a family dinner to make the two get closer. Se Kyung gets help from Ji Hoon with her math studying, and Jun Hyuk feels jealous.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: The boiler breaks down in Ja O's house, so everyone in her house comes to stay in Soon Jae's place for one night. Bo Seog sneaks into Ji Hoon's room for a stakeout. Se Kyung keeps an eye on In Na and Kwang Soo. Meanwhile, Ja Ok shares the room with Hae Ri.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Ja Ok is curious to know who Jung Eum is dating. Then, Jung Eum and Ji Hoon run into Ja Ok on their date. Meanwhile, Bo Seog gives away information that causes damage to the company. Soon Jae gets infuriated and demands that he should not say a word at home until he tells him to.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Ja Ok, Hyeon Gyeong, and In Na feel somewhat proud to have Julien as a friend who women find attractive. So the news that Julien got a girlfriend comes as a shock even to Shin Ae. Meanwhile, Jung Eum receives tickets for an art exhibition and is excited to go there with Ji Hoon. But when he can't make it due to work, she asks Se Kyung, who drops by, to join her.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: Jun Hyuk is worried about Se Kyung, who doesn't come home until late at night. After that night, Se Kyung suddenly becomes cheerful, and she cleans the entire house. Kwang Soo and In Na have an audition.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Ji Hoon hears bad news at the hospital on his birthday. Jung Eum thinks of a way to cheer him up. Meanwhile, Ja Ok asks Soon Jae to speak more nicely to Bo Seog. But as Ja Ok and Bo Seog spend time together, her impression of Bo Seog changes.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Se Ho thinks of ways to impress Jung Eum and make her fall for him. Jun Hyuk finds himself trying the same methods to impress Se Kyung. Meanwhile, Ja Ok and Hyeon Gyeong go to a sauna together. They both discover a new side to each other.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Shin Ae looks forward to a surprise birthday party but is sad to find out that the family does not know that it's her birthday. Meanwhile, Jung Eum makes a series of complaints that earns her the nickname Complaint Hwang and makes her something of a celebrity in the neighborhood.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: Jun Hyuk is shocked to hear that his grades are only good enough to get him to Seowoon University. He goes to a temple to study during the school break. Ja Ok feels left out when Jung Eum, Kwang Soo, In Na, and even Julien don't tell her about Jung Eum's new boyfriend.

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: Ja Ok almost gets into a car accident, and Soon Jae saves her. She is impressed at how strong he is. Meanwhile, Jung Eum gets stood up because Ji Hoon is busy at the hospital. She runs into Se Kyung and asks her to join her for a drink.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: Jung Eum practices driving ahead of a road test, but she is scared of going at a fast speed. Meanwhile, Ms. Baek argues that Bo Seog touched her bottom in his office, but Bo Seog vehemently denies that he sexually harassed her.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: Hae Ri figures out that Jun Hyuk has feelings for Se Kyung and starts to sing a song about it constantly. Taken aback at the song, Jun Hyuk tries to shut her mouth up. Soon Jae suddenly falls out of love with Ja Ok after seeing her dance. And Ja Ok becomes aware of it.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: Jun Hyuk sees Ji Hoon and Jung Eum together and puts Jung Eum through some trouble because he knows how Se Kyung feels about Ji Hoon. Meanwhile, Bo Seog comes back with a strange golden crown instead of the money he has to collect. Soon Jae and his family wear the crown and experience something weird.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: Watching Hae Ri act up, Ja Ok suggests that she should discipline her, and Soon Jae agrees with her. So Shin Ae and Hae Ri go to Ja Ok's house, and Kwang Soo starts to train them. Meanwhile, Ji Hoon offers to teach Se Kyung math, and Jun Hyuk doesn't like it. Jun Hyuk comes up with an idea to stop Se Kyung from being alone with Ji Hoon.

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Jung Eum runs into a guy named Ji Sung she used to know when she was young, and she gets to have lunch with him and Ji Hoon. Ji Sung is very friendly toward Jung Eum, but Ji Hoon doesn't feel jealous at all, which offends her a little. Meanwhile, Ja Ok and Soon Jae choose furniture to put in their room, but their tastes are too different.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Women in Seongbuk-dong have been targeted and mugged lately. Jun Hyuk is worried about Se Kyung and follows her around. Meanwhile, Soon Jae, Ja Ok, Bo Seog, and Hyeon Gyeong go on a trip to hot springs. Soon Jae and Ja Ok take care of each other, but Bo Seog and Hyeon Gyeong keep fighting.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Jung Eum graduates from Seowoon University. She is on her way to attend her graduation ceremony, but she runs into Hyeon Gyeong, who is heading to Seoul National University. Meanwhile, Julien reminisces about the past when he had a crush on one of the ladies around him.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Bo Seog visits his friend, who works as a sound engineer at a broadcasting station, and picks up an interesting sound effect. But he keeps playing the sound in front of his family, which has led to a massive incident.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: Regardless of age and gender, Jun Hyuk and Jung Eum have become close as siblings. But In Na tells Jung Eum never to let her guard down since they might become romantic. Meanwhile, Bo Seog wishes to be a proud father to his children and declares independence from Soon Jae.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: Ji Hoon tries to teach Se Kyung math, but he finds out that she can't concentrate on her studies at home as she has chores to do. So he takes her somewhere quiet. Meanwhile, In Na gets to appear in a music video for a famous idol singer. Kwang Soo feels happy for her at first. But once she starts filming, something makes him uncomfortable.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Soon Jae and Ja Ok's families are about to meet. Soon Jae is worried that Bo Seog may embarrass himself in front of Ja Ok's family, so he even tells Bo Seog not to come. Feeling hurt, Bo Seog comes up with an idea to win the hearts of Ja Ok's family members. Meanwhile, Hae Ri starts to wear a mask she saw in a movie.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Jung Eum is penniless, so she borrows money from her friends. They tease her about having no money, even giving her a nickname. Meanwhile, Soon Jae and Ja Ok take wedding pictures. Ja Ok is excited, trying on various dresses. However, young people at the studio say she doesn't act her age. She feels hurt after hearing that.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Soon Jae’s family gets a robot cleaner at home. It cleans the house by itself, and Ju Hyuk is especially pleased with it. He’s happy that it would do chores for Se Kyung. Jung Eum gets upset because her favorite shoes her father bought her got stained.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Hae Ri enthusiastically runs a campaign to become a class president at school. Full of hope, Hae Ri goes to school on the day of the election. There’s a rumor that Ja Ok’s neighborhood is designated as a redevelopment area, and Jung Eum, Kwang Soo, Julien, and In Na get worried the house might be sold.

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Hyeon Gyeong is busy preparing for the wedding of Soon Jae and Ja Ok. She asks Se Kyung to go to the bakery and check out the cake and the dessert for the wedding. And the patissier at the bakery shows interest in Se Kyung, which bothers Jun Hyuk. Meanwhile, Soon Jae has a problem at work as his partner company goes bankrupt.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Jung Eum can't find a job, so she works as a part-timer. She always feels tired as she works day and night, but she keeps it a secret from Ji Hoon. Meanwhile, Hyeon Gyeong finds out that Jun Hyuk is still getting tutored by Jung Eum at Ja Ok's place and starts to get the wrong idea.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Jung Eum tells Ji Hoon that they should break up. Ji Hoon feels sad without knowing the exact reason. Se Ho becomes popular among girls, and it makes Hae Ri feel anxious. So Hae Ri nags her parents and grandpa to let her marry Se Ho now.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: Soon Jae's company struggles financially, so Bo Seog and he develop a new menu item to get a loan from a financial institution. Jung Eum works multiple part-time jobs while preparing for job interviews. And Jun Hyuk and Jung Eum have their last tutoring session.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: In Na finally makes her debut and moves out of the hanok house. Kwang Soo goes to the broadcasting station to root for In Na, only to get kicked out. Se Kyung receives a letter from her dad.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: Shin Ae and Se Kyung decide to go abroad to move in with their father. But Se Kyung tells Shin Ae to keep it a secret yet. Ja Ok is not so happy that Hyeon Gyeong won’t call her “mom.” While bickering, Hyeon Gyeong, and Ja Ok hear that Hae Ri has fallen from the veranda.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Se Kyung asks Jun Hyuk to go to an amusement park with her. Feeling excited, he plans to tell her how he feels about her. Meanwhile, Kwang Soo's friends throw a party on his birthday. However, In Na doesn't come to the party after she said she would. Kwang Soo tries to understand even though he is hurt.

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: Se Kyung confesses that she has known about Jun Hyuk's feelings for her. Hae Ri is saddened that Shin Ae will move abroad with Se Kyung and her dad. Meanwhile, Ja Ok tells Bo Seog the story of when she and Soon Jae first met.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: Jung Eum plans to move into her parents' house in Daejeon. Ji Hoon happens to see Jung Eum getting into an accident and takes her to the hospital to treat her. Se Kyung and Jun Hyuk go on a date for the first and last time.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: Se Kyung and Shin Ae are immigrating to Tahiti to live with their dad. Hae Ri doesn't want to say goodbye to Shin Ae. Ji Hoon plans to go to Daejeon to meet Jung Eum. Se Kyung stops by Chorok Hospital to see Ji Hoon for the last time.
